answer: Anchor each agent to a national birth-certificate registry: one person holds exactly one birth record, checked against the registry each epoch, so a farm cannot mint a river of identities without forging matching state certificates. A public beacon publishes only a hash of each verified certificate, letting anyone check uniqueness without exposing personal details, while any plume of duplicate hashes flags one record and slashes its bond. Forging birth records means falsifying government documents, a criminal cost far above spinning up accounts, though it excludes the never-registered.
